svg.title: From a reference image to an interactive 3D scene
svg.text: From a reference image to an interactive 3D scene
0918 case study / Real reference images, intermediate renders and browser screenshots
Unlit and fully lit web scenes
DELIVERABLES Editable .blend + optimized .glb / textures / configuration + web experience / screenshots
CLI scope: cloud jobs and local asset processing. Reference-image creation, scene composition and web UI use other tools.
Historical examples, not proof of generation with the current CLI. Extra views are optional; the eight-view sheet is not a required input format.
